_what_this_is: Every image in assets/library/, and what is actually IN it -- who appears,
indoors or out, what time of day, whether Ash is wearing the neckerchief.
Read tools/art_catalog.py for the commands. The short version:
python tools/art_catalog.py check    -- the canon checks. Run this.
python tools/art_catalog.py query --character ash --time night
python tools/art_catalog.py show sc_kettle
HAND-WRITTEN fields (a person looked at the image): title, description,
characters, setting, place, time_of_day, light, ash_neckerchief, notes,
cast_defect, verified.
DERIVED fields, rewritten by `build` -- never hand-edit: prompt,
prompt_source, used_by, prologue_beats, wired.
`verified` says how the hand-written fields were filled in:
"read"   -- the image was opened and looked at. Trust these.
"prompt" -- filled in from the generation prompt and filename only.
Interface chrome, where nothing in it can contradict story
canon. Promote to "read" when somebody looks.
time_of_day: dawn | day | dusk | night | timeless | none
timeless -- an interior or otherworld with no external time cue at all
(the Hollow Court has never had a sky).
none     -- not a place. Skill cards, evidence studies, icons.
setting: interior | exterior | plain | abstract
plain    -- the subject on bare paper, no environment (art rule 5).
ash_neckerchief: true | false | null. null means Ash is either absent or
turned so his throat is not in frame -- nothing to contradict.
